svg.title: SPORTSLINK's animated bot squad
svg.desc: All twelve detailed mini-voxel bot illustrations from the project are lined up on a small strip of grass. Each bot gently bounces, and a pixel football moves between them. The rest of the background is transparent.

svg.title: scout mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original scout robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and BINOCULARS · DISCOVER symbol.

svg.title: courier mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original courier robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and ENVELOPE · MESSAGES symbol.

svg.title: referee mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original referee robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and SHIELD · AUTH + RLS symbol.

svg.title: recruiter mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original recruiter robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and CLIPBOARD · OPPORTUNITIES symbol.

svg.title: mechanic mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original mechanic robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and WRENCH · API + CI symbol.

svg.title: pocket mini-voxel bot
svg.desc: Original pocket robot built from tiny shaded square pixels, with idle animation and PHONE · ANDROID APK symbol.

svg.title: feed Bot
svg.desc: Original feed mini voxel character with small idle and blink animation, representing POSTS · COMMENTS.

svg.title: event Bot
svg.desc: Original event mini voxel character with small idle and blink animation, representing EVENTS · CALENDAR.

svg.title: club Bot
